headingLevels.text: DPP Provider Exit: Keep Product Passports Accessible
Start with the scan that must still work
What the European framework establishes
Six things to settle before choosing a provider
1. Define a usable export
2. Trace the route behind the printed label
3. Preserve permissions along with the information
4. Keep the record's meaning and history
5. Make the recovery copy reachable during failure
6. Name the people who can complete the handover
Rehearse the exit before accepting the service
Put the results into the supplier agreement
If the provider has already announced its departure
What the registry changes, and what to keep checking

Will our passports keep working if the provider closes?

svg.accessibleTitle: Four checks for a proposed provider exit
svg.description: Keep the original product label connected to recoverable records, an authorised replacement and the information each reader may access. This is an editorial exercise, not a completed migration.
